narrative: An interim top-up and the calm after February's surge: 409 codes added, 43 removed (+366 net), and effectively no city changes at all (9 real, 0 encoding).

The only ongoing activity is municipality recoding — 6,080 CSD reassignments, led by New Brunswick (1,819), Ontario (1,294) and Quebec (837) — the tail of the administrative realignment that has run through the whole series.
The handful of real renames are scattered one-offs (Sunnyside → Springfield in Manitoba; Airdrie ↔ Rocky View County in Alberta) with no pattern. This is a maintenance release.

csd_changed: With almost no additions or renames, the 6,080 CSD reassignments are the only substantive activity — the continuing drip of municipal-identifier updates in New Brunswick, Ontario and Quebec that follows each governance change.
